findings.finding: The final inner defTrue tag test has no empty false arm before the outer tag block closes; the existing closing braces make the inner macro consume the outer group terminator as its third argument.
findings.controlling_evidence: Every neighboring iftag call has a true and false arm, and the outer iftag opened on line 37 also requires its own closing true arm and empty false arm.
findings.required_translation_handling: Write the inner form as iftag{defTrue}{...}{}, then close the outer form with }{}; add an adjacent OLTEPLSYN-001 note.

findings.finding: The prvOr branch says the material conditional abbreviates not-A-or-B followed by a closing parenthesis for which no opening parenthesis occurs.
findings.controlling_evidence: The intended classical equivalence is A→B iff not-A or B; the chapter explicitly allows omission of the outermost parenthesis.
findings.required_translation_handling: Remove only the unmatched closing parenthesis and add an adjacent OLTEPLSYN-002 note.

findings.finding: The conjunction case uses equiv between A and the constructed symbol string even though the formation-sequence definition and preceding cases all use ident for syntactic identity.
findings.controlling_evidence: OLP-0058 defines ident as equality of symbol strings; OLP-0060's formation clauses use ident, and the proof must conclude that the last string has the displayed parse, not merely that two formulas are semantically equivalent.
findings.required_translation_handling: Replace equiv by ident in that proof step and add an adjacent OLTEPLSYN-003 note.

findings.finding: The theorem correctly requires agreement on variables occurring in fixed A, but its i.e. clause says a variable occurs in some formula A, which under an existential reading applies to every propositional variable.
findings.controlling_evidence: The theorem heading and conclusion both concern the already fixed formula A; Local Determination requires only the variables occurring in that formula.
findings.required_translation_handling: Render the explanatory clause as occurrence in the fixed formula A and add an adjacent OLTEPLSYN-004 note.
